text.text: Building frontage categories (B to E), staying activity (one circle per person), vehicular movement and pedestrian throughput in the study block.
text.label: Figure

text.text: Our block lies in Villimalé’s industrial area. Its frontage is graded B to E: 61% of it is closed, with 9.7 doors per 100 m.
Staying gathers along a few building edges and the inner lanes round the central block. Traffic is low, under 5 vehicles every ten minutes, and places to linger score 3.0 of 5, the best of the three.
Fewer doors, yet the best place to linger. Street life gathers where edges, routes and uses meet, and quiet streets let walking and staying overlap there.
